newsitem.title: USA: U.S. midweek cash lumber review - June 4.
newsitem.headline: U.S. midweek cash lumber review - June 4.

text.p: Random Lengths Gross List Cash Lumber Prices Quotes:

Comment - Trade views on the lumber cash market were mixed through Tuesday, Random Lengths said in its midweek update. While buying picked up slightly, many mills were still flexible on prices. Traders took note of impending summer shutdowns but many maintained a cautious approach, the reporting agency said.
Shutdowns played a key role in plywood sales, however, while OSB sales picked up on news of a fire at one plant and another company's plans to curtail output, Random Lengths said.

Western S-P-F prices were on firmer footing after Canfor announced temporary closures at four BC mills in mid-June. But some wood continued to trade below last Thursday's levels. Buyers didn't follow through as strongly as mills had hoped, and Tuesday's drop in futures left traders mixed on price prospects.
Eastern S-P-F got a lift from shortcovering last Friday but trading got off to a slow start this week, Random Lengths said.
